posts.topic: Payment Terms Decided Without Supplier Data
posts.hook: Only 15% of organizations weigh supplier financial health when setting payment terms.
posts.key_stat: 66% rate the 2026 supply environment high-risk, yet only 15% integrate supplier financial health into terms decisions.
posts.visual_direction: Clean stat card foregrounding 15% against the 66% risk-perception figure, framing payment-terms extension as a blind decision.
